data.name: Munaaz
data.gender_notes: Munaaz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'naza' meaning 'to help, support'. The name Munaaz signifies someone who provides aid and assistance. The name Munaaz carries the meaning “Support, help” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Munaaz usually hope their child will grow to embody support, help and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the desire to seek closeness to Allah and the longing for His love and blessings
data.etymology: Munaaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Support, help.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Munaaz total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: مناز
in_arabic.long_meaning: مناز هو اسم عربي يعود إلى الجذور القرآنية، مشتق من الفعل نز، يعني النصر والنجاح والتفوق، له意义 روحية عميقة في التراث الإسلامي، ويعبر عن القوة والنجاح في الحياة

in_urdu.name: مناز
in_urdu.long_meaning: مناز ایک عربی نام ہے جو قرآن کی جڑوں سے اخذ کیا گیا ہے، نز کے فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کامیابی اور کامیابی، اسلامی روایت میں اس کا گہرا روحانی معنی ہے، اور زندگی میں قوت اور کامیابی کی علامت ہے

in_hindi.name: मुनाज
